headline: Weathered Expanse and Callahan's Passage Churn Under Heavy Fire
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, ferocious combat has concentrated into Weathered Expanse and Callahan's Passage, each logging a flurry of strategic base transitions over the past two hours. In Weathered Expanse, vicious exchanges around Wightwalk and Crow's Nest have driven Warden casualties above 1,200 in two hours and left three strategic positions entirely in ruins. Callahan's Passage remains equally volatile, where Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage continue to trade control amid more than 2,000 combined casualties in the latest two-hour window. Meanwhile, Mooring County maintains a brutal attritional tempo with over 1,100 combined casualties in two hours, though defensive lines around The Wind Hills have held without fresh turnovers. In contrast, sectors that flared earlier have cooled; Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf recorded no base shifts in the last two hours following earlier skirmishes, while Nevish Line extends its relative pause despite contested ground remaining divided.
